full_prompt_en: A single refined eighteenth-century oil portrait of a young painter pausing over her sketch. She appears from the waist up in a quiet three-quarter turn, with one hand lightly holding a slender brush above an open sheet at the lower edge of the composition. Her gaze meets the viewer with a calm, thoughtful expression rather than a theatrical smile. Her softly curled fair hair is gathered with a pale cream ribbon, and her modest warm beige dress has small passages of delicate ivory lace at the neckline and cuffs. The pose and facial expression carry the image; the sketch and brush are understated, without legible writing. The figure stands in a deep brown interior with only a muted olive passage behind one shoulder, so the face and hands emerge from the darkness. The close oval portrait composition has a dark carved frame visible at the perimeter. The painting has a late eighteenth-century classical portrait character: gracefully idealized but observant facial features, translucent pearly skin, restrained rosy cheeks, tender tonal transitions, and fine controlled brushwork. The curls, folds, and lace are modeled with patient small highlights that never become hard or metallic. Warm directional illumination falls across the forehead, nose, cheek, sleeve, and hand, while the surrounding shadows stay rich and soft. The palette consists of honeyed cream, warm ochre, dusky olive, muted rose, and umber. The surface resembles aged oil paint on canvas with gentle glazing and slight grain, not a glossy digital illustration. The image has an intimate, composed, humane mood and the quiet asymmetry of the leaning figure within the oval.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅精致的十八世纪油画肖像：一位年轻画者在画稿前稍作停顿。腰部以上的近景中，她安静地四分之三转身，一只手轻握细画笔，悬在画面下缘展开的纸张上方。她以平静、若有所思的目光看向观者，表情不夸张。浅金色卷发以淡奶油色缎带束起，穿温暖米色的朴素衣裙，领口和袖口点缀细小的象牙白蕾丝。姿态与神情主导画面，画稿和画笔保持克制，不出现可辨识文字。背景是深褐色室内，只在一侧肩后留一片低饱和橄榄色，面部和双手从暗处柔和浮现。构图是亲密的椭圆形肖像，画面边缘可见深色雕花画框。画风具有十八世纪晚期古典肖像的气质：五官优雅理想化但仍有观察所得的真实感，肌肤如珍珠般透亮，面颊微红，明暗过渡细腻，笔触精巧而节制。卷发、衣褶和蕾丝用耐心的细小亮色塑造，没有硬亮的金属反光。温暖的定向光落在额头、鼻梁、脸颊、衣袖和手上，周围阴影深厚而柔软。色彩限制在蜜色奶油白、暖赭、灰橄榄、淡玫瑰和深棕之间。表面具有陈年布面油画的轻柔罩染和细微颗粒，没有光滑数码插画感。整体情绪亲近、端庄、有人情味，并保留人物在椭圆中微微倾斜的自然不对称。
style_prompt_en: Late eighteenth-century classical oil painting combines graceful idealization with attentive observation. Translucent warm glazing and smooth, gradual transitions between illuminated planes and deep brown shadows establish volume. Honeyed ivory, muted rose, warm ochre, dusky olive, and umber form a restrained harmony. Soft warm light concentrates at the visual focus; surrounding tones recede into nearly black depth with subtle color still visible. Pearly pale passages contrast with small controlled highlights on intricate textures and selectively softened edges. Fine unobtrusive brushwork, aged canvas grain, and mellow varnish create a tactile surface. Close, elegant compositional balance places intimate detail against ample dark tonal support. The atmosphere is poised, tender, and contemplative.
style_prompt_zh: 十八世纪晚期古典油画语言结合优雅的理想化形体与细致观察。透明暖色罩染，以及亮面到深褐阴影的平滑渐变，形成体积。蜜色象牙白、低饱和玫瑰色、暖赭、灰橄榄与深棕构成克制的和谐。柔和暖光集中于视觉重心，周围退入近黑且仍有细微色相的深度。浅色区域呈珍珠般柔亮，细密质感带少量精准高光，边缘有选择地柔化。精巧而不张扬的笔触、陈年画布颗粒与温润清漆形成可触的表面。近距离而优雅的构图以宽厚暗调支撑细节中心，气氛端庄、温柔、沉思。
theme_en: A young painter pausing over her sketch
theme_zh: 一位年轻画者在画稿前稍作停顿
name: Angelica Kauffman
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
